description: [SYNTHETIC] Primary key. Synthetic accident identifier such as ACC0000001; IDs grow in chronological order.
[SYNTHETIC] Date of the synthetic accident.
[SYNTHETIC] Local time of day of the accident.
[SYNTHETIC] Day name, Monday to Sunday.
[SYNTHETIC] Month number, 1 (January) to 12 (December).
[SYNTHETIC] Calendar year of the accident.
[SYNTHETIC] Country of the accident (always United Kingdom in this generator).
[SYNTHETIC] City the accident is attributed to.
[SYNTHETIC] District inside the city for urban accidents, or 'Outskirts <North/East/South/West>' for rural ones.
[SYNTHETIC] Synthetic WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees, inside the city's bounding box.
[SYNTHETIC] Synthetic WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees, inside the city's bounding box.
[SYNTHETIC] Road on which the accident occurred (motorway/A-road number or street name).
[SYNTHETIC] Motorway, Dual Carriageway, A Road, B Road, Local Street or Rural Lane.
[SYNTHETIC] Urban (built-up city area) or Rural (outskirts).
[SYNTHETIC] Junction at the accident site, or 'No Junction'.
[SYNTHETIC] Posted speed limit in km/h (rounded UK limits: 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 112).
[SYNTHETIC] Fatal, Serious or Slight. Equals the worst injury among the casualties.
[SYNTHETIC] Number of vehicle records for this accident in Vehicles.csv.
[SYNTHETIC] Number of casualty records for this accident in Casualties.csv.
[SYNTHETIC] Minutes until the scene was cleared and traffic flowed again.
[SYNTHETIC] Traffic density at the time: Free Flow, Moderate, Heavy or Congested.
[SYNTHETIC] Daylight, Dawn/Dusk, Darkness - Lights Lit or Darkness - No Lighting (derived from sun position).
[SYNTHETIC] Clear, Cloudy, Rain, Heavy Rain, Fog, Snow or Windy.
[SYNTHETIC] Air temperature in degrees Celsius. Missing for a small share of rows (sensor gap).
[SYNTHETIC] Relative humidity, 0-100. Missing for a small share of rows (sensor gap).
[SYNTHETIC] Visibility distance in kilometres. Missing for a small share of rows (sensor gap).
[SYNTHETIC] Wind speed in km/h. Missing for a small share of rows (sensor gap).
[SYNTHETIC] Precipitation intensity in mm per hour (0 when dry).
[SYNTHETIC] Dry, Wet, Icy, Snowy or Muddy.
[SYNTHETIC] Street lighting at the site: Present - Working, Present - Not Working or No Street Lighting.
[SYNTHETIC] Hazard on the road (No Hazard, Pothole, Debris on Road, Oil/Diesel Spill, Stationary Vehicle, Animal on Road, Flooding, Fallen Tree, Ice Patch).
[SYNTHETIC] True if road works were present at the site.
[SYNTHETIC] Single main cause chosen from the contributing factors (or a non-flag cause when no factor applies).
[SYNTHETIC] True if at least one motor vehicle was travelling above the speed limit.
[SYNTHETIC] True if a driver was distracted (phone, passengers, etc.).
[SYNTHETIC] True if a driver was impaired by alcohol or drugs.
[SYNTHETIC] True if reckless or aggressive driving was involved.
[SYNTHETIC] True if road surface or hazards contributed to the accident.
[SYNTHETIC] True if adverse weather (rain, fog, snow, wind) contributed.
[SYNTHETIC] True if a traffic rule was broken (e.g. red light, illegal turn, speeding).
[SYNTHETIC] True if a driver was fatigued.
[SYNTHETIC] Primary key. Synthetic vehicle identifier such as VEH00000001.
[SYNTHETIC] Foreign key to Accidents.accident_id.
[SYNTHETIC] Position of the vehicle inside its accident (1, 2, 3, ...). Vehicle 1 is the main vehicle.
[SYNTHETIC] Car, Motorcycle, Truck, Bus, Bicycle or Van.
[SYNTHETIC] Manufacturer (synthetic catalogue).
[SYNTHETIC] Model name that belongs to the make and vehicle type.
[SYNTHETIC] Year of manufacture (never later than the accident year).
[SYNTHETIC] Accident year minus vehicle_year, in years.
[SYNTHETIC] Estimated speed just before the collision in km/h (0 for parked or waiting vehicles).
[SYNTHETIC] Compass direction of travel.
[SYNTHETIC] What the vehicle was doing (Going Ahead, Turning Left, Overtaking, Parked, ...).
[SYNTHETIC] No Damage, Minor, Moderate, Severe or Total Loss.
[SYNTHETIC] Age of the driver/rider. Empty when the driver is unknown (e.g. hit-and-run).
[SYNTHETIC] Male or Female. Empty when the driver is unknown.
[SYNTHETIC] Years since the driver started driving/riding (licence age). Empty when the driver is unknown.
[SYNTHETIC] Only for vehicles with seatbelts (Car, Van, Truck). Empty = not applicable.
[SYNTHETIC] Only for Motorcycle and Bicycle. Empty = not applicable.
[SYNTHETIC] Normal, Alcohol Impaired, Drug Impaired, Fatigued or Distracted.
[SYNTHETIC] Vehicle colour. Empty for a small share of rows.
[SYNTHETIC] Engine capacity in cubic centimetres. Empty for bicycles (no engine).
[SYNTHETIC] Primary key. Synthetic casualty identifier such as CAS00000001.
[SYNTHETIC] Foreign key to Accidents.accident_id.
[SYNTHETIC] Foreign key to Vehicles.vehicle_id. Empty (NULL) for pedestrians.
[SYNTHETIC] Driver, Passenger, Pedestrian, Cyclist or Motorcyclist.
[SYNTHETIC] Age of the casualty. Drivers/riders share the age of the vehicle's driver. Small share missing.
[SYNTHETIC] Male or Female. Empty when unknown.
[SYNTHETIC] Fatal, Serious or Slight.
[SYNTHETIC] True if the casualty was taken to hospital.
[SYNTHETIC] True if an ambulance / emergency service response was required.
[SYNTHETIC] Only for occupants of cars, vans and trucks. Empty = not applicable.
[SYNTHETIC] Only for motorcyclists, cyclists and motorcycle passengers. Empty = not applicable.
